description: This file defines tracing categories, message formatting functions, and classes related to tracing and logging within the Thunder namespace, specifically for the Trace sub-namespace. It includes category definitions, utility classes for message categories, and timing-based duration logging.

classes.name: Constructor
classes.description: Represents a message with static text, providing access to its data and length.

classes.name: CopyConstructor
classes.description: Represents a copy message with static text, providing access to its data and length.

classes.name: AssignmentOperator
classes.description: Represents an assignment message with static text, providing access to its data and length.

classes.name: Destructor
classes.description: Represents a destructor message with static text, providing access to its data and length.

classes.name: MethodEntry
classes.description: Logs entry into a method, inherits from BaseCategoryType with TRACING metadata.

classes.name: MethodExit
classes.description: Logs exit from a method, inherits from BaseCategoryType with TRACING metadata.

classes.name: Duration
classes.description: Logs duration between a start time and now, with optional formatting.

methods.name: Format
methods.description: Backwards compatible formatting function for strings.

methods.name: MethodEntry
methods.description: Constructor that logs method entry with method name.

methods.name: MethodExit
methods.description: Constructor that logs method exit with method name.

methods.name: Duration
methods.description: Constructors that log elapsed time since startTime, with optional formatting.
